# Mike's Services LLC — LLM Access File
# Septic, excavation, land clearing, demolition contractor — Salina Kansas

> Mike's Services LLC handles septic installation and repair, land
clearing, excavation and trenching, demolition, and building pad
prep across Central Kansas. Owner Mike Adams serves Saline, Ottawa,
Lincoln, Dickinson, Ellsworth, and Cloud counties.
Phone: 785-488-7925
Website: https://mikeservicesllc.com
